items.item_text: Certification: Basic Life Support - CPR (BLS-CPR) (must be obtained within 90 days).
Certification: Basic Health Care Security Officer (BSO).

Required rts in Business Administration, Criminal Justice, Safety Administration, or Emergency Management (or a combination of education and/or job-related experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree).
Experience: Minimum of three (3) years of experience managing a Security/public safety-related program.
Experience: Experience with budgets, program management, policy design, and implementation oversight.
Experience: Law enforcement and/or military security-related experience to include a leadership role.
Provides leadership for Security Services, ensuring the delivery of quality services and regulatory compliance while managing operations to achieve service objectives.
Oversees campus security and the parking force, and actively participates as a member of the Environment of Care and Emergency Management Committees.
Implements and maintains comprehensive inspection, testing, and maintenance programs for all physical and electronic security measures, including dissemination of security assessments.
Assists with Security Management Plan implementation, coordinates responses to critical incidents, and monitors systems for security leaks, fraud, or potential breaches.
Hires, manages, and trains staff to accomplish departmental goals, conducts annual performance reviews, and manages business relationships with external vendors and contractors.
Additional Requirement: DRVDMV completed by Talent Acquisition (must be completed within 30 days of transfer).
